result.question: What was Apple's net income in fiscal year 2025?
result.answer: Apple's net income for fiscal year 2025 (the 52-week period ended September 27, 2025) was $112,010 million (approximately $112.0 billion), as reported in the Consolidated Statements of Operations in its 2025 Form 10-K [0000320193-25-000079:item-8-p001]. This is also confirmed by the XBRL fact for us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss for the period ending 2025-09-27 [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss:2025-09-27]. For comparison, net income was $93,736 million in fiscal year 2024 and $96,995 million in fiscal year 2023 [0000320193-25-000079:item-8-p001].
